## Change
Describe the concrete behavior changed and why.

## Verification
- [ ] Relevant tests/builds were executed and exact results are linked or quoted.
- [ ] Android changes: `:app:assembleDebug` passed, or the blocker is documented.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes were reviewed for secrets, permissions, auth, storage, networking and signing impact.
- [ ] No secrets, keystores, signing keys, tokens or private credentials were committed.
- [ ] Generated APK/release artifacts include immutable hash evidence when applicable.

## Evidence
List workflow run IDs, artifact IDs, hashes, screenshots/log excerpts, or other reproducible evidence.

## Remaining blockers
State unresolved gates explicitly. Do not mark untested behavior as PASS.
